To send a Slack message to the #general channel, you can use the Slack API with a valid API token. Here's the command:

```bash
curl -X POST "https://slack.com/api/chat.postMessage" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"channel": "#general", "text": "Hello, team! This is a test message from our Reactive Agent.", "token": "xoxp-<your-token-here>"}'
```

**Notes:**
1. Replace `<your-token-here>` with your actual Slack API token (e.g., `xoxp-...`).
2. Ensure the bot/user associated with the token has permission to send messages to `#general`.
3. This command uses `curl` (common on Linux) to send a POST request to the Slack API.

If you don't have a token, you can generate one via the [Slack API dashboard](https://api.slack.com/apps).
